items.title: 谷歌DeepMind负责人呼吁美国牵头成立人工智能标准监管机构
items.raw_excerpt: 谷歌人工智能业务负责人德米斯・哈萨比斯于周二提议，由美国牵头设立标准机构，针对各类新型前沿 AI 模型开展国家安全风险检测。哈萨比斯与其他科技巨头高管曾在七国集团（G7）领导人峰会期间，向包括美国总统特朗普在内的各国首脑提议组建美国主导的人工智能联盟。（新浪财经）

title_i18n.zh: 谷歌DeepMind负责人呼吁美国牵头成立人工智能标准监管机构
title_i18n.en: Google DeepMind head urges US to lead establishment of AI standards regulatory body.
title_i18n.es: El responsable de Google DeepMind pide a Estados Unidos que lidere la creación de un organismo regulador de estándares de inteligencia artificial

excerpt_i18n.zh: 谷歌人工智能业务负责人德米斯・哈萨比斯于周二提议，由美国牵头设立标准机构，针对各类新型前沿 AI 模型开展国家安全风险检测。哈萨比斯与其他科技巨头高管曾在七国集团（G7）领导人峰会期间，向包括美国总统特朗普在内的各国首脑提议组建美国主导的人工智能联盟。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: Demis Hassabis, head of Google's AI business, proposed on Tuesday that the US lead the establishment of a standards body to conduct national security risk testing on various new frontier AI models. During the G7 leaders' summit, Hassabis and other tech executives had proposed to world leaders, including US President Trump, the formation of a US-led AI alliance.
excerpt_i18n.es: El responsable de negocios de inteligencia artificial de Google, Demis Hassabis, propuso el martes que Estados Unidos lidere el establecimiento de un organismo normativo para realizar pruebas de riesgo de seguridad nacional en varios nuevos modelos de IA de vanguardia. Hassabis y otros ejecutivos de grandes empresas tecnológicas propusieron a los líderes de países, incluido el presidente estadounidense Donald Trump, durante la cumbre del G7 la formación de una alianza de inteligencia artificial liderada por Estados Unidos. (Sina Finance)

items.title: Pupul, portable and revocable memory you carry into any AI
items.raw_excerpt: A fresh AI meets a stranger by her consented Pupul, on our best model. Then she revokes, and the same AI goes blind mid task. The token is still valid. Access is gone. Sixty seconds, live.

title_i18n.en: Pupul, portable and revocable memory you carry into any AI
title_i18n.zh: Pupul，你带入任何AI的便携且可撤销的记忆

excerpt_i18n.en: A fresh AI meets a stranger by her consented Pupul, on our best model. Then she revokes, and the same AI goes blind mid task. The token is still valid. Access is gone. Sixty seconds, live.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一个新AI通过她同意的Pupul在我们最好的模型上遇到一个陌生人。然后她撤销，同一个AI在任务中途失明。令牌仍然有效。访问已消失。六十秒，实时。
excerpt_i18n.es: Una IA nueva encuentra a un extraño a través de su Pupul consentido, en nuestro mejor modelo. Luego ella revoca, y la misma IA se queda ciega a mitad de tarea. El token sigue siendo válido. El acceso ha desaparecido. Sesenta segundos, en vivo.

items.title: Approv – human approval and a signed audit trail for AI agent actions
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I’m a software engineer who’s been building AI agents for about 1.5 years. I’ve noticed that teams often give agents the ability to perform real tasks, such as refunding money, changing accounts, and writing to production databases, without involving a human in the process. When there is an approval step, there’s no reliable record of who approved what or when. To address this issue, I created Approv. It’s a simple API call that pauses an agent’s risky action and prompts a human to approve or reject it via WhatsApp (with an SMS fallback). Every state change is hashed and signed with Ed25519, ensuring that the audit trail is tamper-evident and can be independently verified by anyone. items.title: Multi-agent social intelligence with Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock
items.raw_excerpt: This post shows how Thrad.ai deployed a multi-agent system with Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that automates the pipeline from prospect discovery through personalized email generation. The post compares two orchestration patterns (Swarm and Graph) with head-to-head benchmarks on latency, cost, and email quality. You’ll also learn how the system scores prospects using weighted criteria, intent classification, and temporal decay, plus governance controls for production deployment.
